Strategy: Apply the sweet-band reward between thirty-five and fifty only when at least five bins are open, keeping the mid penalty always on. This combines the shifted band that worked elsewhere with the best gate found so far, but both the band and the gate are guesses.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if len(bins) >= 5 and r - item >= 35 and r - item <= 50 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
